messages.content: I keep telling myself I'll start being more assertive once I feel more confident.
Honestly, that order is usually backwards, actually - confidence tends to come from practicing assertiveness, not the other way around.
That's kind of annoying to hear because it means I can't wait for it to feel easy.
Fair, honestly - but the good news is you don't need to feel ready, you just need to act slightly uncomfortable a few times until it gets easier.
